rules.message: Use MOUD (opioids), MAUD (alcohol), or "medications for addiction treatment" (all use disorders).
Use lowercase "bup". The merch slogan "XR BUP" is the one allowed uppercase form.
Use person-first language ("a person with a substance use disorder"), not "addict".
Use person-first language ("a person who uses drugs"), not "abuser".

allowPhrasesInsensitive: Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration
National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism
Substance Abuse Treatment, Prevention, and Policy
rules.message: Say "misuse" or "substance use disorder". Keep a proper name (SAMHSA, NIDA, a journal title) or mark the line content-terms-ignore when it is a direct quote.
Say "positive" or "negative" (for example, "urine drug test was negative"), not "clean" or "dirty".
Use person-first language ("people who use fentanyl"), not "fentanyl users" or "drug users".
Advisory only, and it does not fail CI. If this PA means prior authorization, write "prior auth". PA otherwise means physician associate. Do not lint PA globally.

allowlist.reason: SAMHSA card title for the Mainstreaming Addiction Treatment Act. Statute short name, not the treatment acronym.
